network_enforcement: The release checker performs local structured reconciliation and runs the existing target-local Lean replay, whose subprocesses use Bubblewrap with --unshare-net, a read-only host root, a cleared environment, and a fresh temporary output directory. It performs no Lake update/build, dependency fetch/clone/checkout, or .lake mutation.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact ordered six-line blocked release summary

coverage_boundary: Self-tests the exact blocked release decision, current authority bindings, and the existing network-isolated trust-zero warm-cache replay. It does not provide dependency master acceptance, accepted per-node composition, license compatibility, H0/R0, AUDIT-Z, immutable clean input, a cold empty-cache build, offline restoration, complete TCB/SBOM closure, independent signed verification, a deterministic release bundle, THEOREM-Z, or theorem completion.
